description: Source code for architecture utilities related to macOS, including architecture info retrieval and handling of different CPU types and subtypes, with specific support for ARM64 and ARMv7s architectures.

classes.name: NXArchInfo
classes.description: Structure holding architecture information such as name, CPU type, subtype, endianness, and description.

methods.name: ArchInfo_arm64
methods.description: Creates and returns NXArchInfo for ARM64 architecture.

methods.name: ArchInfo_armv7s
methods.description: Creates and returns NXArchInfo for ARMv7s architecture.
